audience: legal, sales and HR teams that send contracts for e-signature with Yousign

useCases.title: Track signature requests waiting for signers
useCases.text: List signature requests filtered by status or name. List the signers of one request to see who has not signed yet.

useCases.title: Read the audit trail of a signed contract
useCases.text: Open a signature request to see its signers and documents. Read the audit trail of a signer who has signed.

useCases.title: Create a draft request from a template
useCases.text: List the templates and pick one. Create a draft signature request from it, then add the signers. A draft sends no emails.

useCases.title: Activate a draft to send the signing emails
useCases.text: Check the draft request and its signers. Activate it to send the signing emails to every signer.

useCases.title: Send a reminder to a pending signer
useCases.text: Find the signer who has not signed yet. Send that signer a reminder email.
